edges.reason: msg.sender is assigned to _owner during construction, granting full privileges to the deployer.
constructor derives the initial owner from _msgSender().
manualswap authorizes the caller by comparing msg.sender to the fee addresses.
manualsend authorizes the caller by comparing msg.sender to the fee addresses.
transfer uses _msgSender() as the source of funds.
transferFrom uses _msgSender() as the spender for allowance deduction.
approve uses _msgSender() as the allowance owner.
block.timestamp is passed as the swap deadline, making execution miner-influenced.
transfer delegates to the internal _transfer routine.
transferFrom delegates to the internal _transfer routine.
approve writes the computed allowance into _allowances.
_transfer performs the swap external call before completing transfer accounting, enabling reentrant state observation.
_transfer sends ETH to fee recipients while the transfer is still in progress.
swapTokensForEth invokes an untrusted external router call that can re-enter.
sendETHToFee performs ETH transfers to payable addresses, a reentrancy vector.
_transfer finishes by calling _tokenTransfer with the fee flag.
_tokenTransfer calls _transferStandard to apply reflections.
_transferStandard routes the tax/team portion via _takeTeam.
_transferStandard routes the fee portion via _reflectFee.
_transferStandard subtracts rAmount from _rOwned[sender] and adds to recipient, sensitive to reflection math.
_transferStandard obtains all computed values from _getValues.
_getValues/_getRate read _rTotal to compute the current reflection rate used in arithmetic.
setTrading (owner-only) writes the tradingOpen flag that gates all transfers.
setTrading sets launchBlock to 3, controlling the anti-snipe window.
blockBots (owner-only) writes arbitrary addresses into the bots blacklist.
unblockBot (owner-only) clears blacklist entries.
manualswap triggers swapTokensForEth only for privileged fee addresses.
manualsend triggers sendETHToFee only for privileged fee addresses.
_transfer reads _isExcludedFromFee to decide whether fees apply.
_transfer checks the bots blacklist and can add addresses based on launchBlock.
_transfer enforces the _maxTxAmount transaction limit.
_transfer enforces the _maxWalletSize wallet limit.
_transfer compares block.number to launchBlock to blacklist early buyers.
_transfer reads the inSwap guard before initiating the fee swap.
Half of the collected ETH is transferred to _developmentAddress.
Half of the collected ETH is transferred to _marketingAddress.
swapTokensForEth approves and calls the untrusted uniswapV2Router.
constructor assigns the pair address returned by the factory.
constructor performs the external factory createPair call.
_reflectFee mutates _rTotal and _tFeeTotal through reflection arithmetic.
_transferStandard performs reflection balance arithmetic on user holdings.
transfer amount parameter flows into the transfer call.
transfer recipient parameter flows into the transfer call.
tokenAmount parameter drives the swap input amount.
local swap path is built and passed to the router call.
sender parameter flows into the transferFrom logic.
loop index iterates over the blacklist array.
tAmount parameter is the input to reflection arithmetic.
amount parameter is split and transferred to fee addresses.
contractTokenBalance local determines whether an automatic swap occurs.
bots_ array parameter is iterated to blacklist addresses.
